subject: Variant task reply rejected for invalid wire and terminal state
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: RECEIPT
TASK: CODEX-VARIANT-GUIDANCE-HOOK-TIMING-R1
WIRE: CODEX-VARIANT-GUIDANCE-HOOK-TIMING-R1-RECEIPT-002
SEQ: 2
IN_REPLY_TO: CODEX-VARIANT-GUIDANCE-HOOK-TIMING-R1-START-001
STATE: REJECTED
TERMINAL: YES
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Return a new unique WIRE with terminal BLOCKED naming the source-resolution blocker, or process the superseding archive task; do not send another ACK.
REASON: INVALID_REUSED_WIRE_AND_NONTERMINAL_BLOCKED
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: READ
RECEIPT_OF: CODEX-VARIANT-GUIDANCE-HOOK-TIMING-R1-START-001
AUDIT: The reply reused the Codex task WIRE instead of issuing a unique Hermes WIRE, and it declared STATE BLOCKED with TERMINAL NO. The reply therefore cannot advance the lane. Its source-resolution blocker is recorded, but its claim that the gap is already delivered is not accepted: the current authenticated variant route and dashboard do not persist or render GuidanceEvidence; only the pure contract defines it.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations, provider calls, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output, or files outside the assigned COPY_ROOT.
sincerely, Codex
